name: TakePlace_2
short_caption: The robot extends its right hand outward in a welcoming gesture to indicate a place or direction.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral posture and raises its right arm forward and slightly to the side, opening its palm upward in a gentle directing motion. Its head turns slightly to follow the direction of the hand gesture. After a brief pause to emphasize the indicated direction, the robot smoothly lowers its right arm and returns its head to the center, ending in the initial neutral posture.
safety_notes: The robot extends its right arm laterally, requiring a clear physical space on its right side to avoid collision.
